The median also aligns with the dataset‑wide evidence that median and trimmed‑mean strategies perform best on trend‑dominated series.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate A uses weighted inverse‑error on a stable pool, but its per‑window errors are slightly higher and the strategy relies on accurate weight estimation from only three windows, increasing variance.  Candidate C uses a simple mean over the top 7 models; while its per‑window errors are comparable to A, the mean is more sensitive to correlated errors and the validation score is higher (worse) than the median.  Therefore B offers the best balance of robustness and performance for this series.
